property_summary: For any recipient other than the whale and any amount, transferAnyERC20Token succeeds and returns true because it forwards tokens to the CALLED-IN tokenOwner; the mutant always routes to the whale, so a token that reverts when asked to send to the whale makes the mutant fail for some fuzzed input while the reference never does.
change_summary: Transfer the tokens to the whale address instead of the specified tokenOwner.
